question: RBI empowers BCs to update KYC. How many advance KYC updation notifications must banks now send to customers?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Three**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Major relief in KYC updation in bank account: RBI empowers BCs to update KYC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **RBI** updated **KYC norms** to make the process more **customer-friendly**.

 
 
• 
 
Now, **Banking Correspondents (BCs)** are **allowed to conduct KYC updates**, including **periodic KYC**.

 
 
• 
 
**BCs** can be **NGOs, SHGs, MFIs, CSOs**, or even **local kirana shop owners** (with bank approval).

 
 
• 
 
Banks must now send **at least 3 advance notices** to customers for **KYC updation**.

 
 
• 
 
Out of these 3, **at least one must be a physical letter**.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to ensure **ease, transparency**, and **accessibility** in the KYC process.
